changelog: Documentation only — no application code changed. There is nothing to gain by updating from 3.2.117.
CHANGELOG.md is a complete history again: it had stopped at 3.2.90 while 27 versions shipped. Entries for 3.2.91 through 3.2.118 are reconstructed from the release notes.
Versions that were committed but never released on their own (3.2.93-3.2.99, 3.2.105-3.2.114) each have an entry, marked with the release that actually carried them.
The README states that hosting and support for St0r are available through MSP Reboot, while keeping it explicit that the software is free to run and that issues are handled in the open either way.
